page.overview:
What is Nizzam al-Latif?

("I, Nizzam al-Latif, am dead. Thanks be to God.")|Nizzam al-Latif, from his Oath of Initiation into the Black Hand, 1536}} Nizzam al-Latif was the most recent hulul of the Assamite antitribu. The hulul leads the Unconquered and is ritually diablerized every 100 years, passing on the blood of the Lasombra Antediluvian which is reportedly in his veins. Al-Latif was also a firebrand dominion of the Black Hand, leading the Sword of Night, a column established by one of the subsect's Tal'mahe'Ra agents before their disappearance.

Al-Latif was initiated into the Black Hand in 1536.
